text:
Aria: Quick flag - qint8-candidate (qint8-2026b) shows a consistent drop on rerank/recall for short multi-choice QA on the new prompt slice. Not massive but repeatable (3.5-5% delta depending on metric).
Ken: Can you scope to which prompt bucket? short-mc or dialog?
Aria: short-mc primarily. Ran a sweep vs baseline (qint8-2026a) with our eval harness. Command I used:
```
./run_eval --model qint8-2026b --prompts promptsets/mc_short_2026.json --metrics rerank,recall@5,bert_score --out /tmp/qint8b_mc.json
```
Top-k reorder: about 95 examples out of 2500 had the gold answer fall out of top3.
Sana: hmm. Could be quant noise or kv-cache interaction. Any sign of truncation/tokenization mismatches?
Aria: spot-checked 10 failures - answers are semantically different, not cut. Example pasted below: 
"Q: Which environment variable sets the timeout?"
- baseline: "Set TIMEOUT_MS in your .env to X and restart the service."
- qint8-2026b: "Adjust the timeout setting in config." (missing file path and specific var name)
Ken: thanks. Tagging @label-bot to create a micro golden audit. We want human verification of 100 worst diffs.
Ken: @label-bot create-batch --name "qint8b_rerank_100" --size 100 --golden true --owners Sana,Elliot --priority urgent
label-bot: Batch qint8b_rerank_100 created. Expected turnaround 10-14 hours. Add :eyes: to allow senior auto-approve.
Elliot: before mass relabel, let's run a duplicate/near-dupe pass. Our dedupe run last week merged many paraphrases; if this is paraphrase reordering it's noise.
Sana: I'll run a fuzzyhash check + semantic sim filter. Command: `python tools/near_dupe_scan.py --input /tmp/qint8b_mc.json --sim_thresh 0.85`
(30m later)
Sana: Report: 6 exact duplicates, 9 high-similar (>0.9), 12 borderline (0.85-0.9). Rest unique. So ~10% near-dup/dup but still leaves a lot.
Aria: OK proceed with golden. Also schedule a tiny live canary: 1% traffic pinned to qint8-2026b routing only for mc_short route. Collect user-feedback events and rerank telemetry.
Ken: created route: canary/qint8b-1pct-mc; job id 80421. I've set retention window for logs to 48h.
Elliot: add a 'pairwise entailment' metric to the canary; we saw that detect semantic weakening on earlier quant drops.
Aria: done — added entailment-runner to the pipeline. Also enqueue a quant-sensitivity matrix: toggles for kv_cache (on/off), prefill_len (0/32), and kernel_flag (fast/precise). Job: `./quant_matrix --model qint8-2026b --vars kv_cache,prefill_len,kernel_flag` kickoff in 45m.
Ken: If golden pass rate < 0.975 or entailment delta > 3% we hold rollout and fall back to qint8-2026a for canary. Decision owners: Aria + Sana + EngOncall.
Sana: labeling plan: blind pair relabel by two senior labelers, adjudication if disagree. Also add adversarial paraphrase step: synthetic paraphrases + rerun. If model fails on paraphrase set, that's a red flag.
label-bot: Golden rule set: pass if agreement >= 0.9 and gold-precision >= 0.92. Alerts to #eng-ml + #eng-oncall on failure.
Elliot: I've created a short eval notebook to compute per-intent behavioral delta and will post results to the canary dashboard: https://console/redwood/canaries/80421 (internal-only).
Aria: I've annotated the promptset metadata: tag = ["qint8b-investigation","mc_short_2026"], provenance = "eval_run:1770500000". Saved snapshot id: snap-17705-mc.
Ken: one more step: run BERTScore and BLEURT across top5 to capture semantic shifts beyond rerank. Add to the sweep.
Sana: will do. Also will check tokenizer config vs qint8-2026a - ensure tokenization pipeline identical (we had a stray whitespace-normalizer change last month).
Aria: good catch. I diffed tokenizers: no config drift found.
label-bot: human batches assigned to Sana, Elliot, returns expected by 2026-03-24 06:00 UTC. React :lock: to require manual rollback if fail.
Elliot: OK monitoring. If we get a spike in canary latency or token-cost > baseline*1.1 we abort automatically.
Ken: thanks all. We'll reconvene once label-bot results + quant-matrix results are in. Short notes: keep non-blocking telemetry up, do not escalate unless thresholds hit. :+1:
Aria: thanks — will update thread with relabel outcomes and quant-sweep artifacts."
